about: Option A of D5: each option carries a short criterion with example objects (the Laya model card recommends detailed criteria). Examples are everyday objects that appear nowhere in validation.json and are not game words, so a pass cannot come from matching the answer key.

hardness.very soft: gives way completely, like whipped cream, a marshmallow or foam
hardness.soft: dents easily, like skin, cheese, soil or a mattress
hardness.medium: gives a little, like cork, cardboard or hard plastic
hardness.hard: barely gives, like bone, a helmet or a wooden door
hardness.very hard: does not give at all, like granite, diamond or a bank vault door

weight.very light: almost weightless, like a bubble, a moth or a button
weight.light: easy to lift with one hand, like an apple, a phone or a shoe
weight.medium: takes some effort, like a chair, a backpack or a dog
weight.heavy: hard for one person to move, like a sofa, a person or a motorbike
weight.very heavy: tonnes of mass, like a bus, an elephant or a tank

roughness.smooth: slides freely, like a mirror, polished tile or still water
roughness.slightly rough: a faint grain, like denim, a cotton towel or a painted fence
roughness.rough: clearly grainy, like a doormat, a dirt path or a cat's tongue
roughness.very rough: coarse and bumpy, like a cheese grater, coral or pumice
roughness.jagged: sharp broken ridges, like saw teeth, barbed wire or cracked flint

contact.a sharp edge slices: a thin edge cuts along, like scissors through a ribbon or an axe splitting a log
contact.a point pierces: a narrow tip goes in, like a needle into fabric or an arrow into a hay bale
contact.a heavy mass crushes: a big weight presses or smashes, like a hydraulic press flattening a can or a steamroller
contact.a surface scrapes along: one surface drags over another, like a shovel on a sidewalk or a skateboard grinding a rail
contact.something fragile shatters: a brittle thing breaks into pieces, like a window pane, a vase or a light bulb

hardness.true: hard, like bone, granite or a helmet
hardness.false: soft, like foam, cheese or a mattress
